Processor Presses are the molds that stamp circuits. Four types exist:

§b-§f Calculation Press: for Calculation Circuits (Pure Certus Quartz)
§b-§f Engineering Press: for Engineering Circuits (Pure Nether Quartz)
§b-§f Logic Press: for Logic Circuits (Pure Fluix)
§b-§f Silicon Press: for Printed Silicon (Silicon item)

You find your first set in Meteorite chests. Use a Meteorite Compass to locate them. Once you have one of each, you can duplicate them in the Inscriber by combining a Press with an Iron Ingot.

Presses are never consumed. They last forever in the Inscriber. The only challenge is getting the first set.

§ePS:§f The Silicon Press is special: you craft it from Printed Silicon and an Iron Block.
